# An orientation session in the wrong room

The new volunteers learned the ticket software in an office without visitors. At the desk, interruptions made the same steps difficult to remember. Compliance training certifies attendance rather than readiness for this room. Pair a first shift with an experienced person and let them decline a task. [[Volunteer handbook]] needs permission to ask for help written as plainly as the till procedure.
